deficiencies.description: The lecturer points out the tumour and the outer surface of the uterus using pointing words ('the tumor is here. This is the outer surface of the uterus') without specifying their spatial relationship, but the rewrite converts these pointing words into the specific description that the tumour 'lies next to' the outer surface.
deficiencies.sourcePassage: You can see that the tumor is here. This is the outer surface of the uterus.
deficiencies.rewritePassage: The tumour lies next to the outer surface of the uterus

considerations.sourcePassage: So you can see again that this is actually circumspect and very separate from the surrounding stroma and the surrounding tissue.
considerations.reason: The lecturer said 'circumspect', which is an obvious slip of the tongue for the standard histological term 'circumscribed'. Replacing it with 'circumscribed' makes the text scientifically correct and is an allowed change.

considerations.sourcePassage: and has, if you like, invaded within this tissue.
considerations.reason: Replacing the colloquial hedge 'if you like' with 'in a sense' is an allowed stylistic change that preserves the hedge.

considerations.sourcePassage: you wouldn't be sampling all over the body
considerations.reason: Rephrasing to 'the whole body would not be sampled' is an allowed grammatical and stylistic passive-voice adjustment that preserves the exact meaning.
